ip_digestive_complete.name: Digestive Complete
ip_digestive_complete.key: Per 2 capsules: 600 mg betaine HCl, 80 mg pepsin, 350 mg ox bile and pancreatic enzymes (from pork)
ip_digestive_complete.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet ND566 Rev. 8/24 (Supplement Facts, opened as text with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-04): per 2 capsules, Enzyme Blend (porcine) protease 35,000 USP, amylase 35,000 USP, lipase 7,000 USP and pepsin (1:10,000) 80 mg; betaine HCl 600 mg; ox bile 350 mg; L-taurine 100 mg; gentian extract 100 mg; dandelion extract 50 mg; fennel powder 50 mg; servings per container 30/90 (60 or 180 capsules); other ingredients gelatin (capsule), microcrystalline cellulose, silicon dioxide, vegetable magnesium stearate; directions 'Take two capsules with each meal or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.'; caution 'Do not use if you have a prior history of or a current peptic or duodenal ulcer. If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' (The 2019 edition, ND566 ©2019, carries the same caution and gelatin capsule; the round-1 note, from a web search of Rev. 3/21, missed both.) The products DB R987 (catalog ND143 10/1/26, as read by the switch charts) gives the same amounts and directions; sizes R987 60C and R987L 180C (price list ND144 10/1/26, via the DB). The serving line names the enzymes without their units, for space. Both check panels print the label's ulcer caution as it reads ('Ulcer, now or ever? Skip Digestive Complete'); gastritis, acid blockers, NSAIDs and steroids are 'ask first' because betaine HCl adds acid (Asher's ulcer and HCl email, 2019-09-05: 'We do not use the conventional way to increase HCL in patients with ulcers'). Animal sources: pork enzymes, ox bile and a gelatin capsule, hence 'Skip Digestive Complete' in both panels' alpha-gal line (the serving line also names ox bile and the pork enzymes). Protocol: NutriDyn 5R GI Restoration Program ND584 Rev. 1/22, REPLACE step, 'This stage occurs during days 1-10 ... Digestive Complete: 3 capsules per meal for 10 days'; the sheet prints the label dose (2 with each meal; 3 per meal is above the label) for the protocol's days 1 to 10. NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R protocol list (CSO) names it under Enzyme/HCL; NutriDyn CSO pearls video chapters (repo onboard pearls page): 'Digestive Complete: dual-phase acid and enzyme support with ox bile'. Daily rhythm: 2 capsules under Morning and 2 under Evening meal; the kit has no midday slot, so the plan line under the rhythm says it goes with all three meals and gives the days (1 to 10). URL: a web search on 2026-11-03 indexes nutridyn.com/digestive-complete (page not opened: nutridyn.com is blocked from this session). PHOTO (SOFT): build/img-src/R987.png is a 360x640 Lanczos 4x stopgap of the 90x160 px chart thumbnail, the only image in reach; the print master is R987_Web or R987L_Web in Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/, and the Dropbox download host is blocked from this session (proxy 403, rechecked 2026-11-04). Stage the master as-is over build/img-src/R987.png and take R987 out of img-src/soft.json; never AI-upscale a label.

ip_gi_integrity.name: GI Integrity
ip_gi_integrity.key: 3 g L‑glutamine, 1 g glucosamine HCl, 400 mg DGL licorice, 300 mg aloe, 200 mg slippery elm, 16.1 mg zinc (as zinc carnosine)
ip_gi_integrity.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet ND431 Rev. 12/24 (Supplement Facts, Berry panel, opened as text with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-04): serving about 1 scoop (8.5 g), about 28 servings; iron 0.49 mg; zinc (as zinc-carnosine) 16.1 mg; L-glutamine 3 g; glucosamine HCl 1 g; apple pectin 1 g; deglycyrrhizinated licorice 400 mg; aloe vera leaf gel extract 300 mg; slippery elm 200 mg; marshmallow, chamomile, okra, cat's claw, MSM, quercetin and prune 100 mg each; L-carnosine (as zinc-carnosine) 62 mg; 'Naturally flavored, gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegetarian'; three flavors, peach tea, chocolate and berry; directions 'Mix one scoop with 6-8 ounces of water or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.'; 'Warning: Do not use if pregnant or nursing.' and 'Caution: If taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The practice kit's GI Integrity handout (repo handouts/nutridyn-practice-kit.pdf) and the products DB entry R327 (GI Integrity, SKUs R325, R327, R328) give the same amounts. Both check panels print the label warning as it reads ('Pregnant or nursing? Skip GI Integrity'). Glucosamine is on the serving line because both panels name it in the blood-thinner line: 2 scoops are 2 g a day, and glucosamine has raised the INR on warfarin (Knudsen JF, Sokol GH. Pharmacotherapy 2008;28:540-8, PMID 18363538). The product is marked vegetarian, so its glucosamine is not from shellfish. 'DGL' = deglycyrrhizinated licorice. Size line: flavors only; about 28 servings is printed for the Berry panel (ND431) and the Peach Tea panel (catalog ND143, via the DB), but not for the Chocolate canister (R328, a different weight in the DB). Dose: the label states no frequency, so the protocol applies: ND584 Rev. 1/22 REPAIR 'Dynamic GI Integrity: 1 scoop twice daily for 10 days (1 canister)'; Asher's GI-MAP protocol email, 2025-01-30 (Calprotectin/Zonulin section): 'Mix one scoop (7g) with 6-8 ounces of water twice daily.' The practice kit: 'GI Integrity is the anchor.' URL: web searches on 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-04 show the /dyn-gi-integrity URL key on NutriDyn's own store pages (the slug does not follow the 'dynamic-' pattern of the GI Defend and GI Restore links; nutridyn.com itself is blocked from this session, so the page was not opened). Photo: build/img-src/R325.png, the 420x420 original web render of the Peach Tea tub (no upscale). Daily rhythm: '1 scoop' morning and evening; the plan line under the rhythm gives the days (1 to 10).

ip_gi_defend.name: GI Defend
ip_gi_defend.key: 2.5 g ImmunoLin (serum‑derived bovine immunoglobulin isolate), from beef serum, not milk
ip_gi_defend.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet ND850 Rev. 12/24 (Supplement Facts, opened as text with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-04): serving about 1 scoop (2.5 g), about 30 servings; calories 10, protein 2 g; Bovine Immunoglobulin Protein Isolate (ImmunoLin) 2.5 g; 'Contains less than 0.05% fractionated bovine blood.'; other ingredients none; gluten-free, dairy-free; directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water or your favorite beverage or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.'; caution 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The products DB R191 (Microbiome Labs switch chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26) gives the same 2.5 g and directions; size R191 75 g (price list ND144 10/1/26, via the DB; about 30 x 2.5 g). 'From beef serum, not milk': ND850 ('serum-derived bovine immunoglobulin', dairy-free) and the NutriDyn Nutritional Support Knowledge Base text quoted in Asher's email of 2022-05-04 ('no lactose'). The beef source is why both check panels' alpha-gal line says 'Skip ... GI Defend'. Claims, ND850's own: 'GI Defend helps support a healthy mucosal immune system' and 'Supports healthy gut barrier function', printed as 'Supports a healthy gut immune system' and 'Supports healthy gut barrier function'. ND850 says the toxins ImmunoLin binds 'naturally occur in the gut during the breakdown and turnover of food', so the sheet no longer says 'microbial' toxins (next to the front page's microbes that read as acting on a disease agent, 21 CFR 101.93(g)(2)). Dose: the label states no frequency, so the protocol applies: ND584 Rev. 1/22 REPAIR 'Dynamic GI Defend: 1 scoop twice daily for 10 days'; Asher's GI-MAP protocol email, 2025-01-30: 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water ... or mix with Dynamic GI Integrity, twice daily.', hence 'with GI Integrity' on the dose band and 'scoop, mixed in' in the daily rhythm, right under the GI Integrity scoop it is mixed into. URL slug: products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc) and a web search on 2026-11-03 (the /dynamic-gi-defend-r191 page is indexed on nutridyn.com; not opened, nutridyn.com is blocked from this session). PHOTO (SOFT): build/img-src/R191.png is a 584x640 Lanczos 4x stopgap of a 146x160 chart thumbnail (no AI upscale); the print master is R191_Web in Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/, and the Dropbox download host is blocked from this session (proxy 403, rechecked 2026-11-04). Stage the master as-is over build/img-src/R191.png and take R191 out of img-src/soft.json; never AI-upscale a label.

ip_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
ip_ultrabiotic_dms.key: 30 billion CFU at manufacture, 7 strains, including S. boulardii (5 billion), L. acidophilus and B. lactis
ip_ultrabiotic_dms.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet ND460 Rev. 7/24 (Supplement Facts, opened as text with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-04): per capsule, at time of manufacture, Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) 5 billion CFU, Lactobacillus reuteri LRC 5 billion, and Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, Lactobacillus plantarum UALp-05, Lactobacillus acidophilus UALa-01, Lactobacillus gasseri UALg-05 and Bacillus coagulans UABc-20 4.167 billion each (the sheet's text says 30 billion CFU per serving; the strain amounts add to 30.8 billion); servings 30/60 (30 or 60 capsules); gluten-free, dairy-free, vegetarian; directions 'Take one capsule daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The products DB R829 (switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26) gives the same seven strains, 30 billion CFU and directions. The serving line names S. boulardii with its own 5 billion (so the number cannot be read as 5 billion of each) and the two strains ND584 asks for, L. acidophilus and B. lactis (Bifidobacterium lactis; Bacillus coagulans is not on the line, so the one 'B.' cannot be read two ways). S. boulardii is a yeast and the other six strains, about 25.8 billion CFU, are bacteria: hence the header 'Add friendly microbes', and the second bullet is the direction to take it 2 hours from antibiotics, which kill the bacterial strains (the round-1 bullet 'antibiotics spare it' held for the yeast only). Two hours: Asher's zonulin case study, 2026-04-24 ('taken at least 2 hours away from any antimicrobial support'), the series' spacing. Protocol: ND584 Rev. 1/22 REINOCULATE, 'This stage occurs during days 1-10', asks for 'a probiotic supplement containing both L. acidophilus and B. lactis', which this formula has (ND584's own example is UltraBiotic Complete, whose only reachable photo is a 160 px thumbnail); Asher's GI-MAP protocol email, 2025-01-30 (high zonulin or calprotectin) lists Akkermansia Plus, Complete or Daily Multi-Strain; the NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R protocol list (CSO) names UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain under Prebiotic/Probiotic. The label dose is printed (the GI-MAP email's 2 a day is above the label), for the protocol's days 1 to 10. Bedtime: the NutriDyn 60-day protocol conversion doc ('UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain 1 cap At bedtime'), which also keeps it away from the Remove-step herbs on the Gut Overgrowth sheet. URL: products.py SLUGS and a web search on 2026-11-03 (nutridyn.com/ultrabiotic-daily-multi-strain is indexed; not opened, nutridyn.com is blocked from this session). Photo: build/img-src/R829.png, the 420x420 original web render (no upscale). Daily rhythm: '1 capsule' at bedtime; the plan line under the rhythm gives the days (1 to 10).

ip_gi_restore.name: GI Restore
ip_gi_restore.key: 12 g protein, 2.5 g L‑glutamine, prebiotics (2.5 g arabinogalactan, 2 g 2’-FL), 500 mg quercetin, 300 mg turmeric, 18.75 mg zinc
ip_gi_restore.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet ND529 Rev. 10/26 (Supplement Facts, Vanilla panel, opened as text with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-04; the text extraction lists the names and the amounts in separate columns, paired here in printed order and checked against the products DB where both have them): serving about 1 scoop (35.78 g), 14 servings; protein 12 g; vitamin D3 10 mcg; folate 185.2 mcg DFE; calcium 254 mg; iron 5.7 mg; magnesium 35 mg; zinc (as zinc picolinate and zinc carnosine) 18.75 mg; L-glutamine 2.5 g; larch arabinogalactans (FiberAid) 2.5 g; 2'-fucosyllactose (2'-FL, GLYCARE) 2 g; L-threonine 500 mg; taurine 500 mg; quercetin (as quercetin dihydrate) 500 mg; aloe vera leaf extract 400 mg; flax seed powder 400 mg; marshmallow root powder 300 mg; turmeric root extract 300 mg; slippery elm bark powder 200 mg; N-acetyl-L-cysteine 200 mg; alpha-ketoglutaric acid 50 mg; L-carnosine 26.5 mg; other ingredients pea protein isolate, natural flavors, organic brown rice protein, carob seed gum, bamboo extract, stevia (so no dairy protein during the dairy break); available in vanilla and chocolate; directions 'Shake canister before scooping. Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water twice daily or as recommended by your healthcare practitioner.'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The products DB R326C (catalog ND143 10/1/26 p.101, as read by the Metagenics and Biotics Research switch charts) gives the same protein, L-glutamine, 2'-FL, arabinogalactans, zinc, vitamin D3, folate and NAC amounts. The serving line now names the 500 mg quercetin and 300 mg turmeric (the round-1 note that they had no amounts was out of date), which fill the competitor's anti-inflammatory phytonutrient slot and put the turmeric of both check panels' blood-thinner line on the page (2 scoops = 600 mg a day on days 11 to 24); NAC was dropped for the room. Both arabinogalactan (a larch fiber) and 2'-FL are prebiotics, so the serving line groups them under that word. The minerals are why the pharmacy panel spaces quinolone and tetracycline antibiotics from the shakes. Size line: flavors only (the 14 servings are printed for the Vanilla panel only). Protocol: ND584 Rev. 1/22 RESTORE & RETAIN step 'Dynamic GI Restore: 1 scoop twice daily, from day 11 to day 24 (2 canisters)', same as the label. Claims: ND529 'support healthy mucin synthesis, epithelial cell health, and tight junction integrity' and FiberAid 'supports the growth of beneficial gut bacteria', printed as 'Supports the gut barrier and its mucus layer' and 'Feeds your friendly bacteria'; NutriDyn CSO pearls video chapters (repo onboard pearls page): 'GI Restore: gut barrier, mucin layer, and prebiotic support'. URL: web search 2026-11-03 indexes the /dynamic-gi-restore slug (not opened, nutridyn.com is blocked from this session). Daily rhythm: its two scoops REPLACE the GI Integrity + GI Defend shakes on days 11 to 24, so they are listed as '1 scoop from day 11' morning and evening, and the plan line under the rhythm (totals written by hand in the module) says 'Days 11 to 24: only GI Restore, 1 scoop twice a day'. PHOTO MISSING: no GI Restore image exists in the repo, the scratchpad, the product DB, the practice kit, any switch chart or Google Drive; the masters are R326V_Web and R326C_Web (420 px) in Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/, and the Dropbox download host is blocked from this session (proxy 403, rechecked 2026-11-04). Stage the 420 px R326V_Web master as-is as build/img-src/R326V.png (never AI-upscale a label; do not list it in soft.json) and this entry picks it up. Never put a different bottle in this slot; hold the sheet back from print until the photo is in.
